insurer_name: IndusInd General Insurance Company Limited (formerly Reliance General Insurance)
residency_requirement: Indian resident only; status change must be reported and policy will be cancelled with refund
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Fixed-benefit hospital cash / surgical procedure benefit policy; 48-month PED waiting period; single premium paid at inception for 1/2/3 year policy term

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day Care Treatment Cash benefit (Basic Benefit 1.3) — fixed daily payout for listed day-care procedures

maternity_coverage.notes: Pregnancy and maternity expenses excluded (except ectopic pregnancy)

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Policy covers medical treatment taken within India only; all payments in Indian Rupees

permanent_exclusions: breach of law with criminal intent
treatment as a consequence of alcohol, tobacco, narcotic or psychotropic substance use
convalescence, rest cure, rehabilitation, custodial care
dental treatment (unless requiring hospitalization due to accident)
notable_exclusions_summary: Fixed-benefit hospital cash / day-care cash product — pays a daily fixed cash amount on listed events. Indemnity-style benefits (room rent, professional fees) are NOT covered. Excludes maternity, dental (except accident), alternative therapy, and out-of-India treatment.
claim_process_summary: Single premium paid at inception; benefits applied per policy schedule on each policy year. Claims processed through IndusInd/Reliance General claims helpdesk.
